versionPairs.description: A real esbuild 0.28.2 `--bundle --minify --format=iife --platform=node` build of the shared node-app source (test/e2e/fixtures/node-app). esbuild 0.28's minified runtime: its CommonJS and lazy-init helpers guard the factory call with `try` (`var a=(n,e)=>()=>{try{return e||n((e={exports:{}}).exports,e),e.exports}catch(o){throw e=0,o}}`, and a three-parameter `__esm`). Detected by that guarded helper shape (spec I2). v1.1.0 perturbs the last dep (adds tripled), the late module's output and the lazy stamp.
